changes.title: Add OAuth2 login support for enterprise SSO
changes.description: Implement OAuth2 authorization code flow to support enterprise SSO providers. Adds new /auth/oauth2/callback endpoint and session token management.
changes.author: sarah.chen

changes.title: Fix race condition in order processing queue
changes.description: Resolves a race condition in the OrderProcessor where concurrent requests could result in duplicate order entries under high load. Added distributed lock via Redis.
changes.author: james.okafor

changes.title: Migrate user_profiles table to new schema
changes.description: Schema migration to support multi-tenancy. Adds tenant_id column, updates indexes, and backfills existing records. Requires maintenance window.
changes.author: priya.nair

changes.title: Optimise product search query - reduce p99 latency
changes.description: Rewrote the product search SQL query to use covering indexes. Benchmarks show 60% reduction in p99 latency from 1200ms to 480ms under load.
changes.author: david.kim

changes.title: Add payment retry logic with exponential backoff
changes.description: Implements retry logic for failed payment gateway calls with exponential backoff (max 3 retries, base delay 500ms). Reduces false payment failures during gateway instability.
changes.author: james.okafor

changes.title: Update Kubernetes deployment manifests for new node pool
changes.description: Updates k8s deployment manifests to target the new high-memory node pool. Adjusts resource requests and limits for order-api and payment-api pods.
changes.author: ahmed.hassan

changes.title: Add product recommendation carousel to homepage
changes.description: New UI component that displays personalised product recommendations on the homepage using the existing recommendation engine API.
changes.author: lisa.wang

changes.title: Patch CVE-2024-38819 in Spring Framework dependency
changes.description: Upgrades spring-core from 6.1.3 to 6.1.14 to patch CVE-2024-38819. No functional changes - dependency upgrade only.
changes.author: priya.nair

changes.title: Deprecate legacy v1 API endpoints
changes.description: Removes /api/v1/* endpoints that were deprecated in Q2 2024. All active clients have been migrated to v2. Breaking change - v1 callers will receive 410 Gone.
changes.author: sarah.chen

changes.title: Update internal dashboard copyright footer text
changes.description: Minor copy update - changes copyright year from 2023 to 2025 in the internal ops dashboard footer.
changes.author: lisa.wang
